offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures lithium-ion battery cells, modules, packs and battery management systems for commercial and specialty electric vehicles. Sells to vehicle makers and fleet operators, using in-house developed cell chemistry, and also provides energy storage systems and related battery services.

primary_products.value: lithium-ion battery packs; battery cells; battery modules; battery management systems; stationary energy storage systems

primary_services.value: battery replacement and maintenance; battery system engineering support; battery recycling and second-life support

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial vehicle OEMs, bus and truck makers, material handling and port equipment makers, fleet operators, energy storage customers

end_markets.value: commercial vehicles; buses and trucks; material handling; ports and mining equipment; stationary energy storage

revenue_model.value: product sales: battery packs, modules and energy storage systems sold to OEMs and fleets; service fees: battery maintenance, replacement and technical services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes battery cells, packs and systems from purchased materials, sold to vehicle OEMs and fleet operators; component supplier: supplies battery systems as components for electric commercial vehicles

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific including China, manufacturing in China and Clarksville, Tennessee

specialization.value: related lines: battery cells, packs, systems and energy storage for commercial vehicles, sharing chemistry and technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to vehicle OEMs, fleet operators and energy storage customers; partners / resellers: integrators and distribution partners in some regions

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: battery safety and transport standards, environmental rules, trade tariffs and export controls, and clean-vehicle incentive rules
